name: editor
description: Game settings, board and tile bitmap editors for RPG Toolkit projects.

commands.title: RPG Toolkit: Refresh the Game view

rpgToolkit.editor.backgroundImage.description: Background image. A picture shown behind the editor's panels. Leave it empty for a plain background. Give a path inside your project, such as Bitmaps/backdrop.png; it is only looked up when the editor opens.

rpgToolkit.editor.showSplash.description: Show the splash screen. Show the title picture while the editor opens.

rpgToolkit.editor.showTips.description: Show a tip when the editor opens. Show one hint about the editor each time it opens.

rpgToolkit.editor.language.description: Interface language. The language of the editor's own words. English is the only language the editor ships.

rpgToolkit.syntax.keyword.color.description: Keyword colour. The colour of RPGCode commands and keywords in the program editor.
rpgToolkit.syntax.keyword.color.patternErrorMessage: Enter a colour as # and six hexadecimal digits.

rpgToolkit.syntax.comment.color.description: Comment colour. The colour of comments in the program editor.
rpgToolkit.syntax.comment.color.patternErrorMessage: Enter a colour as # and six hexadecimal digits.

rpgToolkit.syntax.string.color.description: String colour. The colour of text in quotation marks in the program editor.
rpgToolkit.syntax.string.color.patternErrorMessage: Enter a colour as # and six hexadecimal digits.

rpgToolkit.syntax.number.color.description: Number colour. The colour of numbers in the program editor.
rpgToolkit.syntax.number.color.patternErrorMessage: Enter a colour as # and six hexadecimal digits.

rpgToolkit.syntax.keyword.bold.description: Bold keywords. Draw RPGCode keywords in bold.

rpgToolkit.syntax.comment.italic.description: Italic comments. Draw comments in italics.

rpgToolkit.board.revertToDrawAfterFlood.description: Return to Draw after a flood fill. After a flood fill, switch the board editor back to the Draw tool.

rpgToolkit.board.showVectorPointIndices.description: Show vector point numbers. Draw each point's number beside the points of a vector shape.

rpgToolkit.board.recursiveFlood.description: Flood fill across layers. Let a flood fill continue through every layer instead of the current layer only.

rpgToolkit.board.showNewBoardDialog.description: Ask before creating a board. Show the new-board questions each time you create a board.

rpgToolkit.board.new.coordSystem.description: New board: layout. The layout the new-board questions start with, which is the one you chose for your last new board.

rpgToolkit.board.new.pixelCoordinates.description: New board: use pixel coordinates. Whether the new-board questions start with pixel coordinates on, as in your last new board.

rpgToolkit.board.new.width.description: New board: width. The width in tiles the new-board questions start with.

rpgToolkit.board.new.height.description: New board: height. The height in tiles the new-board questions start with.

rpgToolkit.board.new.layers.description: New board: layers. The number of layers the new-board questions start with.

rpgToolkit.board.startLocationDisplay.description: Show the player start. Where the board editor draws the player's start cross: only on the board the game begins on, or on every board. A game can set this for everyone who edits it.

rpgToolkit.board.objectColor.program.description: Program marker colour. The colour of program markers on a board.
rpgToolkit.board.objectColor.program.patternErrorMessage: Enter a colour as # and six hexadecimal digits.

rpgToolkit.board.objectColor.item.description: Item marker colour. The colour of item markers on a board.
rpgToolkit.board.objectColor.item.patternErrorMessage: Enter a colour as # and six hexadecimal digits.

rpgToolkit.board.objectColor.sprite.description: Character marker colour. The colour of character markers on a board.
rpgToolkit.board.objectColor.sprite.patternErrorMessage: Enter a colour as # and six hexadecimal digits.

rpgToolkit.board.objectColor.vector.description: Vector colour. The colour of vector shapes on a board.
rpgToolkit.board.objectColor.vector.patternErrorMessage: Enter a colour as # and six hexadecimal digits.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Personal editor preferences set by an untrusted project are ignored.
